October 17, 2026


Congratulations to[STC Industrial Group](https://facebook.com/111413721906812) on being named the recipient of the 2026 ABEX Indigenous Business Leadership Award! Presented by Cameco's Dara Hrytzak, this award recognizes Indigenous-owned businesses that demonstrate exceptional leadership, growth, and economic impact in Saskatchewan. We also want to shout out fellow finalists[Miyosiwin Salon Spa](https://facebook.com/564995150207178) ,[Optek Solutions](https://facebook.com/100620112145297) and[Tangles Hair & Beauty Salon](https://facebook.com/228824203973110) along with the rest of this year's nominees and award recipients. Cameco is proud to support the award and to celebrate the Indigenous entrepreneurs, leaders, businesses and employees helping build a stronger Saskatchewan.[#ABEXAwards](https://facebook.com/hashtag/ABEXAwards) #IndigenousBusiness #SaskBusiness
